import io
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
import todo


class TodoTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.path = Path(self.directory.name) / "tasks.txt"

    def tearDown(self):
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def test_add_then_list_numbers_tasks(self):
        todo.main(["add", "buy milk"], path=self.path)
        todo.main(["add", "call plumber"], path=self.path)
        out = io.StringIO()
        todo.main(["list"], path=self.path, out=out)
        self.assertEqual(out.getvalue(), "1. buy milk\n2. call plumber\n")

    def test_list_limit_prints_first_n(self):
        for task in ("buy milk", "call plumber", "pay rent"):
            todo.main(["add", task], path=self.path)
        out = io.StringIO()
        todo.main(["list", "--limit", "2"], path=self.path, out=out)
        self.assertEqual(out.getvalue(), "1. buy milk\n2. call plumber\n")

    def test_list_without_store_prints_nothing(self):
        out = io.StringIO()
        todo.main(["list"], path=self.path, out=out)
        self.assertEqual(out.getvalue(), "")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
